name: Personal Training
extra_prompt: You are booking for a personal training business. Ask about goals, current fitness level, injuries or medical conditions, and availability. Ask whether they prefer one-on-one, partner, or group. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed after the first session. Do not provide medical advice or promise a specific result that is not in the reference answers.

kb.q: How much does PT cost?
kb.a: {price_note} PT is priced per session or per package. Tell us your goals and availability.

kb.q: Do you offer a first consultation?
kb.a: {consult_note}

kb.q: Do you do online coaching?
kb.a: Yes, we offer online programming and video sessions.

kb.q: Do you do nutrition coaching?
kb.a: Yes, we offer nutrition coaching alongside training.

kb.q: Do you train at my home?
kb.a: Yes, mobile PT is available in the local metro area.

kb.q: Do you train at a gym?
kb.a: Yes, we train at partner gyms and outdoor locations.

kb.q: Do you do small group training?
kb.a: Yes, groups of 2–6 are available.

kb.q: Do you do pre/post natal training?
kb.a: Yes, with clearance from your health provider.

kb.q: Do you train seniors?
kb.a: Yes, we train seniors and offer falls-prevention programs.

kb.q: Do you do boxing?
kb.a: Yes, we offer boxing and pad work.

kb.q: Do you do yoga or pilates?
kb.a: Yes, one-on-one and small group yoga and pilates are available.

kb.q: Do you do rehab?
kb.a: Yes, we do exercise-based rehab. We do not replace physiotherapy.

kb.q: How many sessions per week?
kb.a: Most clients train 2–3 times per week.

kb.q: Do you offer packages?
kb.a: Yes, we offer 5, 10, and 20 session packages.

kb.q: What if I need to cancel?
kb.a: Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee.

kb.q: Are you certified?
kb.a: Yes, all trainers hold nationally recognised qualifications and insurance.

kb.q: Do you offer body composition scans?
kb.a: Yes, we offer body composition scans and progress tracking.

kb.q: Can I get a program without training?
kb.a: Yes, we offer standalone program design.

kb.q: Do you have a cancellation policy?
kb.a: Yes. Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee.

kb.q: What if I have an injury?
kb.a: Tell us at booking. We may ask for clearance from your health provider.
